assessment: This work provides a comprehensive analysis of cell state specification of a whole deuterostome organism, the sea urchin Strongylocentrotus purpuratus. It is also vigorous example for the use of single-cell sequencing to identify cell type homologies across evolution. The paper is thus of significant interest to scientists within the broad fields of developmental biology and evolution, as well as to the more specific communities of researchers that use the sea urchin as a model system or those interested in employing the single-cell mRNA-sequencing technology for "non-conventional" (and marine) molecular model systems.
